# Optimized Fixed-Ancestor Bound for Semiprime Mixed-Square Inheritance

**Status:** unconditional asymptotic statement with a finite computational certificate. The local capture sets and all density factors are exact; the selected ancestor set is generated by `semiprime_ancestor_density_optimizer.py`.

The symbolic base theorem using ancestors

\[
B\in\{1,2,3,6,12\}
\]

gives survivor density at most

\[
\frac{208069}{558624}
\approx0.3724669903,
\]

so at least `62.7533%` of squarefree semiprime mixed-square pairs are inherited.

For every additional fixed ancestor `B` whose modulus

\[
m_B=4B-1
\]

is coprime to the accumulated CRT modulus, define the exact unit-square capture ratio

\[
\eta(B)=\frac{|Q_B\cap QR^*(m_B)|}{|QR^*(m_B)|}.
\]

Fixed-modulus semiprime equidistribution then multiplies the survivor density by

\[
1-\frac{\eta(B)}{\varphi(m_B)}.
\]

The accompanying exact optimizer ranks candidate ancestors by the capture probability

\[
\frac{\eta(B)}{\varphi(m_B)}
\]

and greedily selects pairwise-coprime moduli. All products are maintained as exact rational numbers.

Using candidates `B<=500`, the first added ancestors are

\[
5,8,18,15,20,11,21,42,26,60,17,27,48,33,45,35,32,38,66,50,\ldots
\]

with respective moduli `4B-1` pairwise coprime to the base modulus and to all earlier selections.

The resulting rigorous inherited lower bounds are:

| additional ancestors | inherited lower bound |
|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0.6275330097 |
| 20 | 0.6516243108 |
| 40 | 0.6540306803 |
| 80 | 0.6550878120 |
| 120 | 0.6554630271 |

Thus the 120-addition finite certificate proves

\[
\boxed{
\text{inherited proportion}\ge0.6554630271+o(1)
}
\]

and hence

\[
\boxed{
\text{mixed-square primitive survivor proportion}\le0.3445369729+o(1).
}
\]

This is an asymptotic theorem because the ancestor set is fixed once and for all. The only asymptotic input is prime/semiprime equidistribution in the single finite CRT modulus determined by this fixed set. The large size of that fixed modulus does not require any growing-modulus uniformity.

## Comparison with finite census

The exact census through `A<=100000` found

\[
15433/23313\approx0.6620
\]

of squarefree semiprime indices inherited by at least one divisor-modulus ancestor, leaving `7880/23313≈0.3380` mixed-pair primitive.

The optimized asymptotic lower bound `0.65546` is numerically close to that finite inherited fraction, but they are logically different:

- `0.65546` is a rigorous asymptotic lower bound from one fixed finite ancestor certificate;
- `0.6620` is a finite census and is not an asymptotic claim.

No equality or limiting-density conjecture is asserted here.

## Claim boundary

This result concerns only divisor-modulus inheritance of the semiprime mixed-square pair. It does not prove that the residual `34.45%` are exact depths, and it does not prove Type-II universality or the Erdős--Straus conjecture.
